title: Designability of RNA Targets with Up to Two Length-2 Helices
description: Lean 4 formal artifact and manuscript for a theorem in the pseudoknot-free four-letter Watson-Crick maximum-base-pair model with zero minimum base-pair span: every target with no maximal helix of length 1, at most two maximal helices of length 2, all other maximal helices of length at least 3, and no m5 or m3-dot obstruction motif is uniquely designable. Includes verified examples and release audits.
